name: Portugal
sources: GDP about $78bn and population 9.9m (World Bank / INE Portugal, 1990).

Inflation 13.4% (INE consumer price index, 1990), the highest in the European Community that year. Banco de Portugal money-market intervention near 16.5%; the escudo did not enter the ERM until April 1992.
Tax revenue 27% of GDP (OECD Revenue Statistics, 1990) and general government debt 58% of GDP.
Defence 2.7% of GDP (NATO defence expenditure series, 1990). Founder member of NATO in 1949; Lajes in the Azores is the strategic asset. Strength 8.
TFP trend 1.9%: Portugal joined the EC in 1986 and was the fastest-converging economy in it over 1986-1990.
Separatism 0.02 is the constitutional autonomy of the Azores and Madeira, not a live secession movement.
